caption:
Your salary isn't in your credit score. At all. 🤯
Scores look at payment history, balances, history length, new credit and mix.
Someone earning $40k can have a higher score than someone earning $400k.
Did anyone ever tell you income mattered here?
first_comment: What's the weirdest credit myth you've heard? 👇
